
# Om Prakash Behera — Computer Science Engineer & Full-Stack AI Developer

> Official portfolio of Om Prakash Behera (CodeByPrakash / Quasar Om), a Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) student at Government College of Engineering Kalahandi (GCEK), Odisha, India.

- **Native Script (Hindi)**: ओम प्रकाश बेहरा / ओमप्रकाश बेहरा / प्रकाश बेहरा

## About & Background

Om Prakash Behera is an Indian Computer Science Engineer and Full-Stack Developer born and raised in Bhadrak, Odisha. He specializes in artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, cybersecurity, and scalable MERN stack systems. Since beginning his coding journey in 2022, he has developed 30+ production-grade software projects and maintains 100+ public GitHub repositories.

## Education & Credentials

- **Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering (2025 – Present)**: Government College of Engineering, Kalahandi (GCEK Bhawanipatna, Odisha) — Affiliated with Biju Patnaik University of Technology (BPUT Odisha). Admitted through State-Level Lateral Entry (OJEE).
- **Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering (2022 – 2025)**: State Council for Technical Education & Vocational Training (SCTE&VT Odisha) — Graduated with **First Class Honours with Distinction**.

## Geography & Locations

- **Hometown**: Bhadrak, Odisha, India (PIN: 756100)
- **Current Campus Location**: Government College of Engineering, Kalahandi (GCEK), Bhawanipatna / Jaipatna, Kalahandi, Odisha, India
- **Availability**: Open for remote freelance, engineering collaborations, and global opportunities.

## Notable Achievements & Hackathons

- 🥇 **1st Prize Winner (7000 Rs Prize Pool)**: YOUTH@2050 District Level Project Software Exhibition for MRS-AI (AI Medicine Recommender System).
- 💡 **IIM Sambalpur 7-Day IDE Bootcamp (Edition 2 Phase 1)**: Selected & completed 7-day residential Innovation, Design & Entrepreneurship (IDE) Bootcamp at IIM Sambalpur, organized by MoE Innovation Cell (MIC) & AICTE. Mastered design thinking, prototyping, and investor pitch decks.
- 🚀 **ISRO BAH 2026 PS-07**: Bharatiya Antariksh Hackathon — Exoplanet Transit Detection using 1D-CNN Deep Learning.
- 🇮🇳 **Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2025)**: Selected with Team CodeNova for AttendTrue Analytics (AI Smart Attendance & Behavioral Analytics).
- 🌟 **Diploma CSE Distinction**: Graduated First Class with Distinction from SCTE&VT Odisha.
- 📦 **Open-Source Milestones**: 100+ GitHub repositories and 30+ completed software systems.

10. [Running Local LLMs on Consumer GPUs: VRAM Optimization](https://omprakashbehera.me/blog/local-llm-cuda-quantization-optimization) — GGUF quantization, Flash Attention 2 & Ollama CUDA offloading.
11. [Predicting Campus Placements with Supervised Learning](https://omprakashbehera.me/blog/smart-placement-campus-prediction-ml) — Skill gap analytics & placement probability scoring.
12. [Architecting Scalable Tourism & Lab Management Systems](https://omprakashbehera.me/blog/odisha-tourism-management-database-architecture) — 3NF relational schemas, ACID transactions & RBAC.
